newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: China Banking sees 985.65 mln pesos 97 net.
newsitem.headline: China Banking sees 985.65 mln pesos 97 net.

text.p: China Banking Corp said on Friday its net profit in 1997 could reach 985.65 million pesos on an expected surge in fund-based revenues.
The bank recorded net profits of 824.1 million pesos in 1995 and did not give any estimate for 1996.
But the bank said it posted a net profit of 607.85 million pesos in the first nine months of 1996.
In a statement submitted to the Philippine Stock Exchange, the bank said it forecast gross revenues of 6.608 billion pesos in 1997, of which 5.749 billion pesos are fund-based earnings.
Net loans in 1997 are projected to hit 37.441 billion pesos and total assets 65.0 billion pesos, it said.
